### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues block approval of the null-value serialization fix. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes null-value serialization in the shared KQL formatter used by query parameters and the query builder. **Changes:** - Recognizes boxed nil pointers and slices, producing typed null literals instead of panics or `dynamic()`. - Adds table-driven tests for every nullable type through both entry points. - Documents the fix in the unreleased changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the corrected null serialization behavior. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​value.go` | Detects boxed nil pointers and slices before formatting values. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​value_null_test.go` | Verifies typed null literals for parameters and builder expressions. |
Review effort: Max
